point_estimates: Per-query native F1/EM, dataset means and equal-size pooled90 mean

paired_bootstrap.resampling: Within-dataset paired query resampling; preserve dataset weights

inference_limit: Repeatedly exposed development cohort; intervals are descriptive, not selection-free confirmation
case_review: Preserve all final text changes and all native F1 changes; label the review post hoc and distinguish semantic from formatting changes
ordinary_review: Structural and usage summaries cover all176 pairs. Any manual factual review reports its explicit subset and cannot use original-query gold to grade a subquestion.
failure_policy: Algorithm and format failures retained; technical holds explicitly missing. Do not create full90 score or interval from incomplete conditions.
costs: Separate fresh namespace charges from logical goal-final costs and frozen-prefix bookkeeping estimates. Do not call the latter fresh full-RAG execution costs.
